summary: Requires a written food defense plan with vulnerability assessment, mitigation strategies, monitoring, corrective actions, verification and training for actionable process steps.
applies_to: Registered food facilities; most farm activities are exempt (farm activities subject to Produce Safety are exempt; certain on-farm activities of farm mixed-type facilities exempt).
size_thresholds: Very small business (< $10,000,000/yr average human-food sales plus market value of food held, inflation-adjusted, 3-year average) exempt except must document eligibility (21 CFR 121.5(a), 121.3). Also exempt: holding (except liquid storage tanks), intact-container packing/labeling, animal food, certain alcoholic beverages.
